bytecode.description: Hex-encoded EVM bytecode (0x prefix optional). Max 24576 bytes.

accounts.description: BYOS prestate in the same call: balances (wei strings), runtime code, storage, nonce. Empty world otherwise.

balance.description: Wei as decimal string. Omit for default 1 ETH; use "0" for unfunded.

nonce.description: Account nonce as decimal string. Default 0.

code.description: Runtime bytecode already at this address.

storage.description: Optional storage slots to seed (existing-slot SSTORE / SLOAD).

gasLimit.description: Execution gas limit as decimal string. Default 1000000. Max 30000000.

trace.description: Include stack-only opcode trace when true (max 10000 steps).
